title: Marcos looks forward to 'constructive engagement' with US at ASEAN Summit
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday expressed optimism about ASEAN's "constructive engagement" with the United States during the regional summit, saying their meetings are expected to produce…

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday expressed optimism about ASEAN's "constructive engagement" with the United States during the regional summit, saying their meetings are expected to produce outcome documents.

"It's really a very informal kind of summit. Although there will be outcome documents that will arise from that summit, and we are looking forward to ASEAN's constructive engagement with the US in this regard," Marcos said during a press briefing following the conclusion of the 49th ASEAN Summit.
The President, however, did not elaborate on the expected outcome documents.
US President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday afternoon to attend the ASEAN Summit.
Air Force One, carrying Trump and his delegation, landed at the Balagbag Ramp of the Ninoy Aquino International Airport at 5:33 p.m.
Trump's visit has drawn protests from various groups across the country, particularly over the proposed Pax Silica initiative.
US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton, however, said there was no scheduled announcement on the initiative during the ASEAN Summit. —LDF, GMA News
